title: Sign-Ups Are Open for 2027 Rez Gravel
content:
Rez Gravel is an Indigenous-led adventure ride that makes cycling accessible on the Gila River Indian Community. This supported ride goes through the Gila River Indian Community, home of the Akimel O’otham (Pima) and Pee-Posh (Maricopa) tribes. Registration is open for the 2027 event, which takes place January 9th and 10th. Sign-ups are now open.

This is a group adventure ride, not a race, and it will average around 10 miles per hour, so pack a lunch and expect an all-day adventure if you are riding the 60 Mile Big Rez Gravel Route on January 10th.

There are two fee options for each ride: Little Rez Gravel $25 or $50. The Big Rez Gravel is $50 or $100. Funds raised will help Rez Gravel continue the work of helping residents of the Gila River Indian Community learn how to do bicycle repair and maintenance. Funds raised will go towards purchasing tubes, chains, other parts, tools, and supplies as they are needed.

Check out registration at Bike Sign Up and see more at Rez Gravel. Also, check out our Reportage from the 2024 Rez Gravel event in our archives.
